svg.title: Molecule of the day: Diazepam
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Diazepam while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as 2.83.
svg.text: MW 284.7 · cLogP 3.15 · TPSA 32.7 · HBD 0 · HBA 2 · RotB 1
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
